set.body:
Outcome: DL4 coverage and omission, derived deterministically from DL3 (no model call): per source row/scene, which participants recalled it and with which grades; omission = row cited by none of a participant's atoms.
Exit: row-level coverage agrees with human coverage coding on a sample, with denominator and treatment of unverifiable atoms stated. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl4-coverage-and-omission.
set.title: [detail-mapping] DL4 coverage and omission, derived from DL3
